## What's Changed
* Skill: cut what the brief already says, and tighten the rest by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/377
* Real-model checkers: read a group report's status past quotes in the title by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/378
* Real-model tables for the skill at 646112c, on two models by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/379
* Remove courier_status: courier_children already shows it by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/381
* Move the plugin API pin to 2.2.0 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/385
* Subscribe only to the event types the modules handle by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/386
* Carry the role part in a role session instruction entry (spike on #384) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/387
* Real-model rows for the role part in a session instruction entry (#384) by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/388
* Pass the person's message up as its own rule, and drop a status sent downward by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/390
* Carry the project's lessons and a parent's standing in session instruction entries by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/391
* Release 0.13.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/392


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.12.0...v0.13.0

## What's Changed
* Add issue and pull request templates by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/362
* Add a Claude Code review of pull requests by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/363
* Document steering a running tree through a child by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/367
* Pass a child's mid-run finding on to its siblings by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/368
* Default real-model.sh to deepseek-v4.1-flash-free from OpenCode's catalog by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/371
* Skill audit: leaves, root-only recall, answering from below, a review stage; maxDepth 5, maxTotal 30 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/372
* Let the parent choose a child's model and variant in courier_spawn by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/374
* Let the parent choose per spawn whether a child is a native subagent by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/375
* Release 0.12.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/376


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.11.1...v0.12.0

## 0.11.1

**Works with OpenCode 2.1.4.** Tested and pinned against the latest OpenCode release.

**Children run on the right model on every OpenCode version.** When you spawn a child with an agent that has its own model, the child now always runs on that model. On OpenCode before 2.1.4 it used to fall back to OpenCode's default model instead.

## What's Changed
* Bump the OpenCode pin to 2.1.4 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/358
* Pass the named agent's model to session.create by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/360
* Release 0.11.1 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/361


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.11.0...v0.11.1

## Know when a limited child can try again

When a child session hits a provider's rate or quota limit and the provider says how long to wait, the courier now passes that on.

- **The parent session is told when to retry.** Its failure notice gives the wait and the time it ends, and asks it not to message the child before then, since that would only fail again. It can set a `courier_later` reminder for when the wait is over instead. (#353)
- **The tree panel shows it too.** The failed child's row reads `limit, resumes 14:32` until that time passes or the child runs again.

## Tested on OpenCode 2.1.3

The courier now targets OpenCode 2.1.3. Nothing changed in how it behaves. (#352)

## Shorter docs

The README and reference are now about half their previous length, and each topic is covered in one place. (#354)

## What's Changed
* Bump the OpenCode pin to 2.1.3 by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/352
* Trim the human-facing docs to what a reader needs by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/354
* Show when a rate- or quota-limited child can resume by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/355
* Release 0.11.0 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/356


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.10.3...v0.11.0

## What's Changed
* Record and narrate the README demo with scripts: record-demo.sh, render-demo.sh by @ivopogace in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/350
* Release 0.10.3 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/pull/351


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ivopogace/opencode-courier/compare/v0.10.2...v0.10.3
